Makefile rules for version files and Rust builds of fdctl, solana, and agave-ledger-tool.

# Purpose
This Makefile fragment defines version handling and build rules for the `fdctl` application and related Rust tools. It generates `src/app/fdctl/version.h` from the current FIREDANCER version and commit data, then uses that header to keep the build in sync with the source revision. It also adds object files for `fdctl` core modules, sets up the `fdctl` Rust binary and helper targets such as `cargo-validator`, `cargo-solana`, and `cargo-ledger-tool`, and enforces checks for the `agave` submodule and Rust toolchain version before cargo builds run. Additional rules handle compiler-specific flags for `gcc` 15 and `clang` 20, and copy built artifacts into the local output directories used by the rest of the build system.
